# cleaning dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
x <- c(1)
movies <- read.csv("moviedata.csv")
movies_clean <- movies
movies %>% map(~sum(is.na(.)))

movies_clean$Run.Time <- movies$Run.Time %>% str_extract_all("\\d+") %>% map(~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  map(~.[1] * 60 + .[2]) %>% unlist()

km <- function(string){
  if(is.numeric(string)){
    
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "K")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_extract_all(string, "\\d+")) * 1000
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "M")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_extract_all(string, "\\d+")) * 1000000
  }
  num
}
km("298K")
```

```{r runtime cleanup}
movies_clean$Run.Time <- movies$Run.Time %>% str_extract_all("\\d+") %>% map(~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  map(~.[1] * 60 + .[2]) %>% unlist()
```

```{r imdb review cleanup}
km <- function(string){
  if(str_detect(string, "K")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "M")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000000
  }
  num
}

km(movies$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings)

movies$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings %>% map_dbl(~km(.))
